company.name: ScyllaDB
company.shortDescription: ScyllaDB produces a NoSQL database compatible with Apache Cassandra and Amazon DynamoDB at 10x the throughput with reliably low latencies.
company.description: ScyllaDB is the monstrously fast and scalable database for today's terabyte-scale and beyond data intensive applications. ScyllaDB is available as open source and enterprise offerings that can be run anywhere, and ScyllaDB Cloud, a fully-managed Database as a Service (DBaaS) available on AWS and Google Cloud. ScyllaDB supports wide-column NoSQL workloads fully compatible with Apache Cassandra and Amazon DynamoDB. ScyllaDB was founded under the name Cloudius Systems. As Cloudius Systems, the company pioneered the unikernel trend with the development of OSv, designed from the ground up to execute a single application on top of a hypervisor for superior performance and effortless management.

productsAndServices.description: A distributed NoSQL database for high-throughput, low-latency applications, compatible with Apache Cassandra through CQL and with DynamoDB through Alternator.
productsAndServices.name: ScyllaDB

productsAndServices.description: A fully managed ScyllaDB database service running on AWS and Google Cloud, with managed operations, elastic scaling, backups, monitoring, and support.
productsAndServices.name: ScyllaDB Cloud

productsAndServices.description: A commercial distribution of ScyllaDB with tested binaries, enterprise features, cluster administration tools, hot fixes, ScyllaDB Manager, and 24/7 technical support.
productsAndServices.name: ScyllaDB Enterprise

productsAndServices.description: An integrated vector search capability for storing embeddings and performing approximate nearest-neighbor queries alongside operational data in ScyllaDB.
productsAndServices.name: ScyllaDB Vector Search

productsAndServices.description: A DynamoDB-compatible API that lets existing DynamoDB applications use ScyllaDB with the same client SDKs, data models, and queries.
productsAndServices.name: ScyllaDB Alternator

productsAndServices.description: An open-source Kubernetes operator for deploying and managing ScyllaDB clusters, including installation, scaling, upgrades, and operational automation.
productsAndServices.name: ScyllaDB Operator
